prompt: User says 'commit and push everything including extensions'

assertions.name: submodule_committed_first
assertions.description: Extensions submodule committed before main repo
assertions.check: Extension commit message appears in transcript before main commit

assertions.name: main_references_submodule
assertions.description: Main repo commit includes submodule reference update
assertions.check: Main commit message or log shows Extensions submodule hash update

assertions.name: correct_branches
assertions.description: Extensions pushed to main, main repo to development
assertions.check: Push output shows 'main' for Extensions and 'development' for main repo

assertions.name: all_cleaned_up
assertions.description: Both repos clean after push (nothing to commit)
assertions.check: Final git status shows 'working tree clean' for both
